01 / ABOUT USTHE COMPANY BEHIND THE SOLUTIONS

Useful technology.
For everyone.

Technology shouldn’t be expensive to be useful.

Aminosoft Global is a technology brand focused on affordable, practical software for everyday business needs. Whether you run a small shop, work independently, or provide a service, professional tools should be within your reach.

We develop ready-to-use products for common challenges and custom software when your business needs something different. Our starting point is Sri Lanka, with a long-term commitment to helping businesses grow.

◎
OUR VISION

Opportunity through accessible technology.

To make useful technology accessible to ordinary people and businesses, opening up new possibilities for everyday work.

↗
OUR MISSION

Software that makes a difference.

To develop affordable, reliable, and user-friendly software that simplifies everyday work and creates meaningful value for small businesses and independent workers.
